name: wiswork
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test:runtime-policy && npm run test:codex-release && npm run test:macos-packaging-runner && npm run test -w @wiswork/agent-runtime && npm run test -w @wiswork/codex-bridge && npm run test -w @wiswork/office-bridge && npm run test -w @wiswork/auth && npm run test -w @wiswork/i18n && npm run test -w @wiswork/electron-utils && npm run test -w @wiswork/font-metrics && npm run test -w @wiswork/docx-engine && npm run test -w @wiswork/file-parse && npm run test -w @wiswork/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @wiswork/pptx-render && npm run test -w @wiswork/presentation-ops && npm run test -w @wiswork/presentation-verification && npm run test -w @wiswork/ai-search && npm run test -w @wiswork/agent-core && npm run test -w @wiswork/agent-harness && npm run test -w @wiswork/ai-provider && npm run test -w @wiswork/project-store && npm run test -w @wiswork/latex-project && npm run test -w @wiswork/latex-compiler && npm run test -w @wiswork/pdf-viewer && npm run test -w @wiswork/latex && npm run test -w @wiswork/docs && npm run test -w @wiswork/sheets && npm run test -w @wiswork/shell && npm run test -w @wiswork/slides && npm run test -w @wiswork/pdf && npm run test -w @wiswork/markdown && npm run test -w @wiswork/office-addin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/agent-runtime && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/codex-bridge && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/office-bridge && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/auth && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/presentation-ops && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/presentation-verification && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/agent-harness && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/latex-project && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/latex-compiler && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/pdf-viewer && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/latex && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/ui && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/docs && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/shell && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/slides && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @wiswork/office-addin
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,latex,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,magenta,white "npm run dev:renderer -w @wiswork/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @wiswork/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @wiswork/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @wiswork/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @wiswork/markdown" "npm run dev:renderer -w @wiswork/latex" "DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5176 MARKDOWN_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5177 LATEX_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5178 npm run dev -w @wiswork/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @wiswork/docs && npm run build -w @wiswork/sheets && npm run build -w @wiswork/slides && npm run build -w @wiswork/pdf && npm run build -w @wiswork/markdown && npm run build -w @wiswork/latex && npm run build -w @wiswork/office-addin && npm run build -w @wiswork/shell
scripts.build:e2e:slides: WISWORK_SLIDES_ACCEPTANCE_E2E=1 npm run build -w @wiswork/slides && node tools/check-slides-e2e-artifact.mjs present
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @wiswork/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @wiswork/shell && npm run test:runtime-package
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @wiswork/shell && npm run test:runtime-package
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @wiswork/shell && npm run test:runtime-package
